title: As Pakistan and Afghanistan declare truce, civilians in Kabul count the cost of war
summary: At the Emergency Hospital, dozens crowded around a thick book to check the names of the victims killed in an airstrike on a rehabilitation center. The U.N. says over a hundred people were killed.
